blocks.zh: 前言、導論與範圍 — 針式注射系統的規範框架
blocks.en: Foreword, Introduction and Scope: The Framework for Needle-Based Injection Systems

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 ISO 11608-1 的標準結構及其在組合產品（Combination Products）開發中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the structure of ISO 11608-1 and its role in combination product development

blocks.zh: 掌握針式注射系統（NIS）的定義範圍與排除事項，避免誤用標準
blocks.en: Understand the defined scope of needle-based injection systems (NIS) and what is excluded, to avoid misapplying the standard

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 11608-1 與 ISO 14971（風險管理）、ISO 13485（裝置品管系統）的關聯性
blocks.en: Understand how ISO 11608-1 relates to ISO 14971 (risk management) and ISO 13485 (device quality management systems)

blocks.zh: 熟悉 NIS 核心術語，能在客戶稽核和技術轉移討論中正確使用
blocks.en: Become familiar with core NIS terminology so you can use it correctly in customer audits and technology transfer discussions

blocks.zh: Foreword — ISO 11608-1 的標準發展脈絡
blocks.en: Foreword: How ISO 11608-1 Developed

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: Part 1: Needle-based injection systems (本文件)
blocks.en: Part 1: Needle-based injection systems (this document)

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ISO/TC 84 的職責
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Role of ISO/TC 84

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 84（Technical Committee 84）專門負責「藥品施用裝置與血管內導管」領域的國際標準。ISO 11608 系列由此委員會主導，成員包括全球注射裝置製造商（BD、Becton Dickinson 等）及藥品審查機構。
blocks.en: ISO/TC 84 (Technical Committee 84) is responsible for international standards on administration devices for medicinal products and intravascular catheters. The ISO 11608 series is led by this committee, whose members include injection device manufacturers worldwide (BD, Becton Dickinson, etc.) and drug regulatory authorities.

blocks.zh: ISO 11608 共有 5 個 Part，分工明確：
blocks.en: ISO 11608 has five parts, each with a clear scope:

blocks.zh: Part 1：整體系統要求（本標準）
blocks.en: Part 1: Requirements for the overall system (this standard)

blocks.zh: Part 2：針頭規格
blocks.en: Part 2: Needle specifications

blocks.zh: Part 3：容器（cartridge/syringe）規格
blocks.en: Part 3: Container (cartridge/syringe) specifications

blocks.zh: Part 4：電子/電機筆型注射器
blocks.en: Part 4: Electronic/electromechanical pen injectors

blocks.zh: Part 5：自動化功能（自動注射器）
blocks.en: Part 5: Automated functions (autoinjectors)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: ISO 11608 系列就像一套「汽車安全標準」：Part 1 規範整車系統性能，Part 2 規範輪胎，Part 3 規範油箱。各 Part 各有專責，但系統驗證需要全部符合。
blocks.en: Think of the ISO 11608 series as a set of car safety standards: Part 1 governs the performance of the whole vehicle, Part 2 governs the tires, and Part 3 governs the fuel tank. Each part has its own responsibility, but system verification requires compliance with all of them.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，客戶帶入的自動注射器（autoinjector）涉及 Part 1（系統）+ Part 5（自動功能），都需要在技術轉移時確認合規。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, an autoinjector brought in by a customer involves Part 1 (the system) plus Part 5 (automated functions), and compliance with both must be confirmed during technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：第三版重要修訂
blocks.en: Key Point: Important Changes in the Third Edition

blocks.zh: 2014 年第三版有幾個關鍵修訂，影響測試計劃：
blocks.en: The 2014 third edition made several key revisions that affect test plans:

blocks.zh: EMC 測試樣本數從 5 支增加到 20 支（更嚴格）
blocks.en: The sample size for EMC testing increased from 5 to 20 units (more stringent)

blocks.zh: 循環測試溫度從 25°C 調整為 5°C ± 3°C
blocks.en: The cycling test temperature changed from 25°C to 5°C ± 3°C

blocks.zh: 自由跌落測試中移除了 B 和 D 系統設計
blocks.en: System designs B and D were removed from the free fall test

blocks.zh: 若客戶提供的 Design Verification（DV）報告是 2012 版（第二版）基礎，需確認關鍵差異是否已重測。
blocks.en: If a customer's Design Verification (DV) report is based on the 2012 edition (second edition), confirm whether the key differences have been retested.

blocks.zh: Introduction — 設計哲學與風險導向方法
blocks.en: Introduction: Design Philosophy and the Risk-Based Approach

blocks.zh: 歷史背景：「Type A 相容性」為何被廢除？
blocks.en: Background: Why Was "Type A Compatibility" Withdrawn?

blocks.zh: 早期 ISO 11608-1 試圖建立一個「通用針頭規格」（Type A），讓不同廠商的針頭和注射器可以互換。理念很好，但實際上：
blocks.en: Earlier versions of ISO 11608-1 tried to establish a "universal needle specification" (Type A) so that needles and syringes from different manufacturers would be interchangeable. The idea was sound, but in practice:

blocks.zh: 零件間尺寸公差累積 → 多廠商組合後整體功能無法保證
blocks.en: Tolerance stack-up between components meant that overall function could not be guaranteed once parts from multiple manufacturers were combined

blocks.zh: 客戶往往假設 Type A = 100% 互換，忽略了系統測試
blocks.en: Customers often assumed Type A meant 100% interchangeability and skipped system-level testing

blocks.zh: 結果：更多召回和不符合事件
blocks.en: The result: more recalls and nonconformances

blocks.zh: 第三版的解決方案：廢除 Type A 標籤，要求製造商明確標示「已測試過的組件組合」，並鼓勵供應商之間簽訂品質協議。
blocks.en: The third edition's solution: withdraw the Type A label, require manufacturers to state clearly which combinations of components have been tested, and encourage quality agreements between suppliers.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的直接影響
blocks.en: Key Point: Direct Impact on CDMOs

blocks.zh: 此修訂對 CDMO 的含義：
blocks.en: What this revision means for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 客戶的 autoinjector 需提供「針頭 + 容器 + 注射器的整體測試報告」，不能只說「符合 Type A」
blocks.en: A customer's autoinjector must come with an integrated test report covering the needle, container and injector together; a statement of "conforms to Type A" is not enough

blocks.zh: CDMO 在技術轉移時應要求客戶提供 Functional Compatibility Matrix（功能相容性矩陣）
blocks.en: During technology transfer, the CDMO should ask the customer for a Functional Compatibility Matrix

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 自行外購針頭，需要確認與客戶注射器系統的相容性測試資料
blocks.en: If the CDMO sources needles itself, it must confirm it has compatibility test data against the customer's injector system

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：風險導向設計
blocks.en: Analogy: Risk-Based Design

blocks.zh: 標準說「遵循風險導向方法，可能產生不同於本標準的產品特定要求」，這不是逃避責任，而是承認：
blocks.en: The standard says that following a risk-based approach may lead to product-specific requirements that differ from those in this standard. This is not an evasion of responsibility; it acknowledges that:

blocks.zh: 胰島素筆型注射器（每天多次注射、精密劑量）與疫苗自動注射器（一次性、0.5 mL 固定劑量）的風險輪廓完全不同，不能用同一套測試規格一刀切。
blocks.en: An insulin pen injector (multiple injections per day, precise dosing) and a vaccine autoinjector (single use, fixed 0.5 mL dose) have completely different risk profiles, so one set of test specifications cannot be applied to both.

blocks.zh: 這正是 ISO 14971（風險管理）被列為規範性參考的原因——先做風險評估，再決定哪些測試適用。
blocks.en: This is exactly why ISO 14971 (risk management) is listed as a normative reference: do the risk assessment first, then decide which tests apply.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某客戶帶來一支新型 autoinjector，聲稱針頭符合舊版 Type A 規格。根據第三版 ISO 11608-1，CDMO 應要求客戶提供哪些額外文件？
blocks.en: A customer brings a new autoinjector and claims the needle conforms to the old Type A specification. Under the third edition of ISO 11608-1, what additional documents should the CDMO ask the customer to provide?

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 的「抽樣計劃不能替代 ISO 13485 品管系統」這句話，在 CDMO 的 QMS 架構下意味著什麼？
blocks.en: ISO 11608-1 states that a sampling plan cannot replace an ISO 13485 quality management system. What does this mean within a CDMO's QMS framework?

blocks.zh: Section 1: Scope — 適用範圍與邊界
blocks.en: Section 1: Scope: Applicability and Boundaries

blocks.zh: NIS 的適用範圍解析
blocks.en: Understanding the Scope of NIS

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 適用的 NIS 類型（以 CDMO 常見產品為例）：
blocks.en: NIS types covered by ISO 11608-1 (using products common in CDMOs as examples):

blocks.zh: ✅ PFS（預充填注射器）：製造商充填，單劑量，含針頭系統
blocks.en: ✅ PFS (prefilled syringe): manufacturer-filled, single dose, includes a needle system

blocks.zh: ✅ Pen Injector（筆型注射器）：搭配可替換 cartridge，多劑量
blocks.en: ✅ Pen Injector: used with a replaceable cartridge, multiple doses

blocks.zh: ✅ Autoinjector（自動注射器）：預設劑量，自動驅動 → 還需 ISO 11608-5
blocks.en: ✅ Autoinjector: preset dose, automatic drive → ISO 11608-5 also applies

blocks.zh: ✅ Wearable injector（穿戴式注射器）：大容量，可能含電子元件 → ISO 11608-4
blocks.en: ✅ Wearable injector: large volume, may include electronic components → ISO 11608-4

blocks.zh: ❌ 針頭式注射器（Needle-free injectors，如 jet injectors）
blocks.en: ❌ Needle-free injectors (e.g., jet injectors)

blocks.zh: ❌ 終端用戶充填設備（如 BD Uniject 充填機）
blocks.en: ❌ User-filled devices (e.g., the BD Uniject filling machine)

blocks.zh: 規範性參考的重要性：ISO 14971 是核心
blocks.en: Why Normative References Matter: ISO 14971 Is Central

blocks.zh: ISO 14971（醫療器械風險管理）被列為規範性參考，意思是：不做 ISO 14971 風險分析就不能合規 ISO 11608-1。
blocks.en: ISO 14971 (risk management for medical devices) is listed as a normative reference, which means: without an ISO 14971 risk analysis, you cannot claim compliance with ISO 11608-1.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的含義：
blocks.en: What this means for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 客戶的 Design History File (DHF) 必須包含 ISO 14971 的 Risk Management File
blocks.en: The customer's Design History File (DHF) must include an ISO 14971 Risk Management File

blocks.zh: 技術轉移審查時，需確認 Risk Management File 已更新以反映 CDMO 製造環境
blocks.en: During technology transfer review, confirm that the Risk Management File has been updated to reflect the CDMO's manufacturing environment

blocks.zh: IEC 62366（可用性工程）亦為強制參考 → 需要 Human Factors 研究資料
blocks.en: IEC 62366 (usability engineering) is also a mandatory reference → human factors study data is required

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：規範性參考 vs. 建議性參考
blocks.en: Analogy: Normative vs. Informative References

blocks.zh: 規範性參考（Normative）：就像法律條文中的「依據本法...」，引用的標準是執行本標準的必要條件，不能選擇性遵守。
blocks.en: Normative references: like "in accordance with this Act..." in a legal text, the cited standard is a necessary condition for implementing this standard and cannot be followed selectively.

blocks.zh: 建議性參考（Informative）：就像法律條文的「參考說明」，提供背景知識但非強制。
blocks.en: Informative references: like the "explanatory notes" in a legal text, they provide background knowledge but are not mandatory.

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 的 Normative References 清單中，ISO 14971 和 ISO 13485 都是強制性的——這意味著審查 ISO 11608-1 合規性時，稽核員也會查 Risk Management File 和 QMS 記錄。
blocks.en: In the Normative References list of ISO 11608-1, both ISO 14971 and ISO 13485 are mandatory. This means that when an auditor reviews ISO 11608-1 compliance, they will also check the Risk Management File and QMS records.

blocks.zh: Section 3 & 4: Terms, Definitions & Symbols — 核心術語與符號
blocks.en: Sections 3 & 4: Terms, Definitions & Symbols: Core Terminology and Symbols

blocks.zh: 術語解析：CDMO 視角下的 NIS
blocks.en: Interpreting the Terms: NIS from a CDMO Perspective

blocks.zh: NIS（針式注射系統） 是本標準最核心的術語，涵蓋範圍比多數人預期的更廣：
blocks.en: NIS (needle-based injection system) is the central term of this standard, and it covers a wider range than most people expect:

blocks.zh: 預充填注射器（PFS）本身 = 容器（Part 3 規範），加上針頭 = NIS（Part 1）
blocks.en: A prefilled syringe (PFS) on its own is a container (governed by Part 3); adding a needle makes it an NIS (Part 1)

blocks.zh: 胰島素筆型注射器 = 含可替換 cartridge 的多劑量 NIS
blocks.en: An insulin pen injector is a multi-dose NIS with a replaceable cartridge

blocks.zh: 自動注射器 = 含自動驅動功能的 NIS（額外需符合 Part 5）
blocks.en: An autoinjector is an NIS with an automatic drive function (it must additionally comply with Part 5)

blocks.zh: CDMO 的職責通常止於「製造並充填容器（PFS/cartridge）」，客戶負責裝置組裝。但裝置（NIS）的設計驗證資料仍需在技術轉移時審查。
blocks.en: A CDMO's responsibility usually ends at manufacturing and filling the container (PFS/cartridge), while the customer is responsible for device assembly. However, the device (NIS) design verification data still needs to be reviewed during technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 劑量準確性（Dose Accuracy）的重要性
blocks.en: Why Dose Accuracy Matters

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 的核心要求之一就是劑量準確性。幾個關鍵概念：
blocks.en: Dose accuracy is one of the core requirements of ISO 11608-1. Several key concepts:

blocks.zh: Vset：測試時選用的三個設定劑量（最小、中間、最大）
blocks.en: Vset: the three set doses selected for testing (minimum, intermediate, maximum)

blocks.zh: Dose Delivery Efficiency：特別適用於單劑量系統（B1, D1），評估「能打出多少比例的充填量」
blocks.en: Dose Delivery Efficiency: applies especially to single-dose systems (B1, D1) and evaluates what proportion of the filled volume can be delivered

blocks.zh: Minimum Deliverable Dose：製造商擔保的最低給藥量——直接影響安全性聲明
blocks.en: Minimum Deliverable Dose: the lowest dose the manufacturer guarantees to deliver, which directly affects safety claims

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，充填量（Fill Volume）的精確控制直接影響客戶的 Dose Delivery Efficiency 數據，是充填製程驗證的關鍵指標。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, precise control of fill volume directly affects the customer's Dose Delivery Efficiency data and is a key indicator in filling process validation.

blocks.zh: 符號解讀：k 值（容許極限因子）
blocks.en: Reading the Symbols: The k Value (Tolerance Limit Factor)

blocks.zh: 符號表中的 k（tolerance limit factor） 是整個劑量準確性測試的統計核心：
blocks.en: The k (tolerance limit factor) in the symbol table is the statistical core of the whole dose accuracy test:

blocks.zh: k 值從 Annex B 的大型統計表中查取，依據樣本數 n 和機率含量 p 決定
blocks.en: The k value is looked up in the large statistical tables in Annex B, based on the sample size n and the probability content p

blocks.zh: 判定公式：x̄ + k·s ≤ 上限，且 x̄ − k·s ≥ 下限
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion: x̄ + k·s ≤ upper limit, and x̄ − k·s ≥ lower limit

blocks.zh: k 值越大 → 測試越寬鬆；n 越大 → k 值越小 → 測試越嚴格
blocks.en: The larger the k value, the more lenient the test; the larger n is, the smaller k is, and the more stringent the test

blocks.zh: Annex B 的大表格（3000+ 行）讓許多工程師望而生畏，但理解了背後的統計邏輯後，核心就是「以樣本統計量推估母群體分布」。
blocks.en: The large tables in Annex B (3000+ rows) intimidate many engineers, but once the underlying statistical logic is understood, the core idea is simply to estimate the population distribution from sample statistics.

blocks.zh: 客戶要求 CDMO 充填一批自動注射器（autoinjector）用 cartridge，充填量為 1.0 mL。根據 ISO 11608-1 的術語，這個系統屬於哪種 System Designation？（提示：單劑量、製造商充填）
blocks.en: A customer asks the CDMO to fill cartridges for an autoinjector with 1.0 mL. Under the ISO 11608-1 terminology, which System Designation does this system fall under? (Hint: single dose, manufacturer-filled)

blocks.zh: 技術轉移文件中，客戶提供的 Dose Accuracy 規格用「Dose Delivery Efficiency ≥ 95%」來表達，這與哪個 ISO 11608-1 術語直接對應？
blocks.en: In the technology transfer documents, the customer's Dose Accuracy specification is expressed as "Dose Delivery Efficiency ≥ 95%". Which ISO 11608-1 term does this correspond to directly?

blocks.zh: CDMO 在充填驗證中，哪個工藝參數最直接影響 V<sub>meas</sub> 的變異（s 值）？
blocks.en: In CDMO filling validation, which process parameter most directly affects the variability (the s value) of V<sub>meas</sub>?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: ISO 11608 是系列標準：Part 1（本文件）規範整體 NIS 系統，Part 2-5 分別規範針頭、容器、電子元件、自動化功能；CDMO 處理的 PFS/autoinjector 通常涉及 Part 1+3，自動注射器還需 Part 5
blocks.en: ISO 11608 is a series of standards: Part 1 (this document) governs the overall NIS, while Parts 2-5 cover needles, containers, electronic components and automated functions respectively; the PFS/autoinjector products a CDMO handles usually involve Parts 1 and 3, and autoinjectors also require Part 5

blocks.zh: Type A 相容性概念已廢除：第三版要求製造商基於實際測試結果標示已驗證的組件組合，不能再依賴通用相容性假設
blocks.en: The Type A compatibility concept has been withdrawn: the third edition requires manufacturers to state the verified component combinations based on actual test results, and general compatibility assumptions can no longer be relied on

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 是強制性前提：ISO 11608-1 的規範性參考包含 ISO 14971（風險管理），無風險分析文件就無法完整合規
blocks.en: ISO 14971 is a mandatory prerequisite: the normative references of ISO 11608-1 include ISO 14971 (risk management), so without risk analysis documentation full compliance is not possible

blocks.zh: 劑量準確性是核心：Vset（設定劑量）、Vmeas（測量值）、k 值（容許極限因子）構成整個測試系統的統計骨架，CDMO 充填精度直接影響這些指標
blocks.en: Dose accuracy is the core: Vset (set dose), Vmeas (measured value) and the k value (tolerance limit factor) form the statistical backbone of the whole test system, and the CDMO's fill accuracy directly affects these indicators
